article.title: Meningitis cases surge in Gaza as deteriorating living conditions put children at risk
article.author: Tareq S. Hajjaj
article.content: With meningitis cases rising more than eightfold in October, overcrowded displacement camps, contaminated water, and collapsing sanitation systems are creating conditions for the disease to spread across the Gaza Strip.
